designationHistory.indexText: Sacramento River National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1989 to protect riparian habitat along the Sacramento River between Red Bluff and Princeton.
designationHistory.note: FWS-only sources (fws.gov: established in 1989). The FWS Realty record lists a 1988 act (102 Stat. 1778) authorizing land acquisition, which may relate. No independent record found.

sources.name: FWS, Sacramento River NWR Final CCP (2005)
